style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

source.scene: Inspect the named asset collection; do not use an unrelated active scene

target.interpretation: Reward useful native modeling and decoration inspired by the target. Do not reject a change solely because it differs from the source. Reject target drift only when it harms the chosen style, readability, role or locked technical contract. Original part counts and weak shapes are not automatically constraints.

familyContinuityReference.instruction: Independently inspect this object original and target, then inspect exact approved family reference as continuity context. Preserve actual functional connector planes/profile and coherent shared join-surface treatment. Required independently assembled joined previews use exact approved sibling bytes/native source as declared; do not infer this object approval from family approval. New useful native shape design elsewhere is allowed, part counts not locks.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: A substantial cobalt canyon wall termination with softly worn native stone volumes, readable interlocking large courses, controlled local crevices and an intentionally finished exposed end. It joins the exact approved middle as one formation at the authored west port and remains coherent in every registered facing and at phone scale.

aestheticCriteria.outcome: Broad interlocking stone masses have rounded worn edge turns and useful large/small rhythm. The east termination is deliberately finished and solid. Model more than a flat slab with rectangular stickers; avoid a tiny repeated brick grid or a uniformly noisy crag. The target inspires construction rather than dictating exact part count or cracks.
observe: native enlarged and whole logical192×352 views

aestheticCriteria.outcome: Coherent cobalt/azure stone with clear blue midtones and restrained cyan turning edges. Deep seam darkness stays narrow/local; no original near-black lower dead mass, large blank face, washed-out glare, halo or artificial dark outlining. Shared connector material, boundary albedo/normal and light match the canonical middle. Softness must survive every facing without a preferred horizontal light direction or cast ground shadow.

Purposeful broad facets, creases and a restrained number of nested small stones establish native depth and craftsmanship. The exposed end and reverse side receive coherent construction, not an unfinished cap, floating plate or featureless panel. Small details support larger forms and may simplify when small; no photographic speckle or pixel clutter.

Same-handed end.W→exact-middle.E assemblies rotated through all4 read as a continuous formation. The shared cut has identical outer profile and compatible side tangent, albedo and material response, without a bright vertical strip, black crease, protruding cap, split crown, alpha gap or doubled overlap band. An allowed normal/storage tolerance cannot excuse a visible seam.
observe: native assembled sources at one-cell root pitch
independently captured catalog atlases at128/32/47.3 pitches and fractional phases
whole-frame shared-native-canvas output on light/gray/dark backgrounds

aestheticCriteria.outcome: Native geometry has no reversed faces, coplanar flicker/black patches, accidental holes, clipped corners or floating base. Fixed root/camera/projection/atlas registration remains exact. No target card, image warp, per-view fitting/recolor, view-specific lighting or manual pixel repair.
observe: all4 complete native frames and atlases

modelingFreedom: Replace awkward slab topology and redundant source parts; six original meshes/92 original vertices/76 base polygons are descriptive, not locks.
Improve nonconnecting face/crown/end forms, proportions, rounded faceting and purposeful details within the functional contact/clearance budget.
The east exposed face has no port; its old thin strata trim and exact AABB extremum are not a requirement to retain an awkward old termination.
Use native geometry/normals/materials appropriate to the chosen design. Preserve shared boundary treatment and declare/pack any actual dependencies.
Do not require the target’s different canvas, literal tall front proportions, painted halo, every pebble or unseen geometry.
requiredEvidence: Exact editable saved .blend and native recipe/settings/resources, hash-bound packet, with portable render-only reopen verification.
Every four static native768×1408 frames, four published384×704 complete atlases, correct frame/root/sourceScale/timing and all-view native audit.
Whole-frame light/gray/dark all4 sheets at native/logical/phone use sizes; inspect source images or hash-bound whole-frame contact sheets.

Independently assembled exact-approved-middle joins in meaningful all4 directions, same-handed roots one unit apart, plus declared reversed-middle scope/residuals; connected native geometry preview complements independent atlas evidence.

Actual consumer or frozen bounded fixture with explicit draw ordering, nearest sampling restored after native-canvas resize, then ordinary filtering of the completed whole canvas. Fractional phases and32/47.3/128 cell pitches; phone390×844 and landscape844×390. Real product page responsive/layout checks remain required when integration changes.
No unmeasured overlap. Any proposed overlap/sampling/family change needs measured justification and coordinator reconciliation before freezing/review.

rootClarification.sameHandedConsumer: Actual catalog descriptor has endS@(2,2) and middleS@(1,2), with authored handedness explicit. Mandatory same-handed W↔E through all4; reversed-middle geometry/albedo diagnostic retained, not simultaneous exact color equality to immutable E and W.
rootClarification.toleranceScope: Float storage only; no fitting, offsets, added overlap, visible seam or poor imagery accepted through numerical threshold.
rootClarification.canonicalCapture: Exact approved middle Cycles48 BOX width1.5 seed0 noDenoise Standard, native4x wholeBOX2x. Dock EEVEE0.5 is unrelated.
rootClarification.sourceDesignFreedom: Weak six-mesh slab/old trim/dark base/part counts not locks. Improve volume, purposeful forms and exposed termination within finite functional contact/envelope.

delivery.scope: Refine this object only. Root coordinator promotes approved atlases, sources and metadata to production, publishes the PR preview, and finally updates Godot.
delivery.notes: Write source/round-NN.blend or the actual native 2D source as appropriate; full native captures, original-layout atlases, previews, validation and delivery.json. Do not label 2D artwork as a Blender model.
